Clearing and grubbing shall be limited to only that area within the construction limits. Woody material present shall be salvaged, stored, and reincorporated into the project as
described in Section 3.03 of the specifications. Excess waste material shall be removed from site for disposal. Protect and preserve trees where indicated in the plans; refer to
removals sheets. If removal of an unspecified tree is not necessary for construction activities, tree shall remain.

Compensation shall be at the Contract unit price for lump sum per plan
quantity. Quantity based on area of vegetation impacted by proposed
grading.

All materials, labor, and equipment necessary for clearing and grubbing.
Construction fencing
Removal, storage, and resinstallation of designated disc golf baskets and
signage

Contractor shall be responsible for stripping, salvaging, stockpiling, and spreading existing topsoil from the areas of proposed excavation and earth fill (grading limits). Topsoil
shall be respread to a minimum depth of 8 inches over all disturbed areas outside of the streambed and proposed rocked or paved surfaces. The proposed surface indicates the
finished grade; surface shall be undercut prior to placing topsoil.

Compensation shall be at the Contract unit price for cubic yard of material
per plan quantity. Quantity based on grading limits and 8-inch thickness.

All materials, labor, and equipment necessary for topsoil stripping,
stockpiling, and spreading.

Perform grading as detailed in the plans. Contractor is responsible for removal and disposal of excess material that is not incorporated into the project. Per the digital terrain
model, there is a net cut volume; no bid item has been included for additional fill. Plan quantity includes a 1.35 fill factor. See Section 4.05 of the special provisions for a detailed
breakdown of earthwork volumes. A digital terrain model can be provided within 5 working days' notice to aid in machine control grading; however, the plan documents shall
control. The digital terrain model indicates the finished grade.

Compensation shall be at the Contract unit price for cubic yard of material
per plan quantity.
Compensation will not be made for excavation of additional material without
prior approval of the Engineer/Owner.

All materials, labor, and equipment necessary for excavation and grading.
Repair and reset of an eroded concrete pipe apron upstream of the
pedestrian bridge. Subgrade preparation for all improvements.
